items: salt + pepper, to taste + chilli flakes
10 grams gouda OR any cheese you like

method: Cook mushrooms then add spinach with all seasonings and allow to wilt then set aside in a bowl

caption:
Mushroom & Spinach Omlette
under 300 calorie | 15 minute breakfasts 

If you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, drop a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 9 | F: 15 | P: 19
Calories: 257 per serve (without bread)
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs (2 grams)
knobb of butter
40 grams button mushroom
50 grams baby spinach 
salt + pepper, to taste + chilli flakes
10 grams gouda OR any cheese you like
 
method
cook mushrooms then add spinach with all seasonings and allow to wilt then set aside in a bowl
in the same pan, cook the beaten eggs in the pan, flip it over and place the mushroom spinach mix, top with cheese
fold and serve it hot  with sourdough bread OR as is :)
